name: com.insumermodel/insumer
description: Read-first blockchain verification. ECDSA-signed booleans across 37 chains. 27 tools.

environmentVariables.description: InsumerAPI key (starts with insr_live_). Either this or INSUMER_PAYMENT_KEY.
environmentVariables.name: INSUMER_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Private key of a throwaway Base wallet holding a little USDC, for pay-per-call via x402 when no API key is set. Each quote is checked before signing.
environmentVariables.name: INSUMER_PAYMENT_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Most USDC the server will pay for one call in pay-per-call mode (default 3).
environmentVariables.name: INSUMER_MAX_PAYMENT_USDC
